title: PR tool relocation and global discoverability

completion_criteria.text: MSP-1: models learn the centralized PR tool BEFORE hitting the gate - CLAUDE.md bullet plus a globally-visible self-triggering pr skill
MSP-2: PR tool relocated out of the mitosis lib to a neutral path, gate selfwrap updated atomically, no shim at the old path
Both MSPs shipped as stacked PRs, each independently correct, CI green, merged
Review the pre-existing CRITICAL gate bypass in block-destructive-bash.sh that MSP-2 inherited unchanged
Fix the gate false-positive where prose merely naming a denied command is blocked; merge branch has no selfwrap escape hatch
Add a refresh step for deployed ~/.claude/lib copies, which are regular files unlike the symlinked hook
Fix basename-keying in no-self-merge-consent.test.mjs by pairing prefix and dir as the sibling scanners do

spine.active_goal: Clear the four follow-ups left by the PR-tool relocation: the pre-existing gate bypass, the gate prose false-positive, the deployed-copy question, and the basename-keying test fix.

open_risks.text: Verify c6's premise before acting on it — the home lib directory is itself a symlink into the repo, so files under it are not separate deployed copies and may need no refresh step at all
Do not attribute the one npm test failure to your own change — it reproduces on pristine main, so it predates this work
Confirm the threatened verdicts on #39 are acceptable, or schedule the missing tests — invariants M3 and M4 were recorded threatened rather than clean, and the PR merged that way

key_decisions.title: Relocate the PR tool to .claude/lib/git/pr.mjs with no shim at the old path
Teach the PR tool through a global skill and a CLAUDE.md bullet, keeping the gate as backstop
Rewrite the bash gate to parse-then-decide-per-command rather than patch its regexes
